CHAPTER.CAPTION: Sons of Korah
CHAPTER.VERS: O clap your hands, all you people. Shout to God with the voice of joy.
For Jehovah the Most High is to be respected. He is a great King over all the earth.
He subdues peoples under us and nations under our feet.
He chooses our inheritance for us, the grandeur of Jacob whom he loves.
God has ascended with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.
Sing praises to God, sing praises; Sing praises to our King, sing praises.
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with a contemplative poem.
God rules over the nations, God sits on His holy throne.
The princes of the people have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham. For the rulers of the earth belong to God! He has ascended to the heights.
